previous_audits.verdict_rationale: Issue: both runner implementations verify algebraic consequences of a supplied six-mode CAR/q-state fixture, cutoff, angle parameters, and equal split, but the packet provides no authority deriving that fixture as a physical input port; for the embedded negative boundary, N1 alternatives such as exchange symmetry, carrier labeling, normalization, dynamics, and readout require added structure, while N2 has only the single split-underdetermination boundary and N3 fixture/scope terms are non-load-bearing. Why this blocks: the result closes only conditionally on those inputs; N4 has no cited witness, N5 is local to the stated channel/block computation, N6 supplies no physical-fixture selector, N7's strongest equal-exchange-symmetry steelman selects alpha=1 only by adding symmetry, and N8 shows no applicable packet-grounded retirement of the conservation identity. Repair target: provide a retained bridge theorem selecting the six-mode carrier, hop, q-state momentum ledger, and numerical fixture, then rerun both implementations and the negative-boundary stress checks. Claim boundary until fixed: the 6,776-column n_left,n_right<=2 counts, number preservation, weights, transpose symmetry, recoil ledger, and conservation non-selection are supported only for the explicitly stated fixture.
